title: Downregulation ofdue to Loss of VHL Protein Expression Promotes the Malignancy Progression of Kidney Renal Clear Cell Carcinoma.
snippet: Kidney renal clear cell carcinoma (KIRC) is the most common subtype of renal cell carcinoma, accounting for 75-80% of cases. Although Prohibitin 1 () has been implicated in tumorigenesis, its role in KIRC remains unclear.
